Exercise: Two-Arm Kettlebell Clean

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
intermediate

Movement Patterns:

- compound

Primary Muscles:

- shoulders

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings
- lower back
- traps

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
2.5

Energy Requirement:
high

Recovery Time:
48 hours

Goals:

- hypertrophy
- strength

Contraindications:

- condition: Shoulder instability, description: Individuals with shoulder instability should avoid this exercise due to the overhead nature of the movement.

Exercise Variations:

- name: One-Arm Kettlebell Clean, force: pull, level: intermediate, mechanic: compound, primaryMuscles: ['shoulders'], secondaryMuscles: ['calves', 'glutes', 'hamstrings', 'lower back', 'traps']

Substitution Options:

- name: Two-Arm Dumbbell Clean, equipment: dumbbells

Instructions:

- Place two kettlebells between your feet. To get in the starting position, push your butt back and look straight ahead.
- Clean the kettlebells to your shoulders by extending through the legs and hips as you raise the kettlebells towards your shoulders. Rotate your wrists as you do so.
- Lower the kettlebells back to the starting position and repeat.
